description: This file defines a Kotlin object JpegSizeLimiter with a method to compress JPEG images to a specified byte size limit, including associated data classes for representing the compression result. It contains logic for iterative quality reduction and scaling of images.

classes.name: JpegSizeLimiterResult
classes.description: Data class representing the result of JPEG compression, including compressed bytes, width, height, and quality.

methods.name: compressToLimit
methods.description: Compresses an image to stay within a specified byte size limit through iterative quality reduction and scaling, returning the best compressed result.
